space: metres, right-handed, +Y up, ground Y=0, origin = detonation point

interpolation.outside: clamp to [0, duration_s]; an element exists only for first_sample/rate <= t <= (first_sample + sample_count - 1)/rate and is not drawn outside

track.layout: sparse, element-major: for each element in id order, sample_count x 16 f32 LE covering samples first_sample .. first_sample + sample_count - 1, starting at byte_offset; no header
track.padding: each alive range is padded by one sample at scale 0 / dissolve 1 on each side where the timeline allows

lod_presets.rule: draw puffs whose lod_rank < preset (subdivision children carry their root parent's rank) and multiply their scale by elements[].lod_scale[preset]; spikes always drawn

wind.runtime: rotate the whole effect about +Y only

mass_height_rule: per sample: max over visible puffs of (py + 0.5 * sx), at least 1.0 m; interpolate linearly; used as h = P.y / mass_height
